boundaries.title: Postgres trust-state authority
boundaries.evidence: Postgres is the source-of-truth store for network trust state.

boundaries.title: Authority artifact publication
boundaries.evidence: Authority rows can be projected into ordered signed-artifact publication inputs.

boundaries.title: NATS JetStream propagation
boundaries.evidence: Single-operator pilots may validate event subjects without a live multi-node broker.
boundaries.remediation: Enable NATS propagation after Postgres persistence and publication workers are durable.

boundaries.title: Verifier cache read model
boundaries.evidence: Verifier cache materialization converts published trust state into scan-time lookup rows.

boundaries.title: Scanner-visible decision runtime
boundaries.evidence: The runtime emits scanner-visible green, orange, and red decisions.

boundaries.title: Scanner-fleet evidence packet
boundaries.evidence: The scanner-fleet evidence packet covers minimum green, orange, and red scanner outcomes.

boundaries.title: Cross-surface QR evidence packet
boundaries.evidence: Cross-surface evidence proves one QR artifact produces the same final scanner-visible decision across surfaces.

boundaries.title: Worker operations evidence packet
boundaries.evidence: Worker evidence covers artifact publication, event outbox propagation, verifier-cache materialization, scanner decision runtime, monitoring thresholds, and replay/recovery drills.

boundaries.title: Publication custody audit export
boundaries.evidence: Publication-worker reports are converted into public-safe signing custody audit exports with published and failed rows preserved.

boundaries.title: Managed signing custody
boundaries.evidence: Reference deployments may use deterministic signing fixtures while preserving the custody boundary.
boundaries.remediation: Move signing into KMS, HSM, or equivalent managed custody before production issuance.

boundaries.title: Live runtime-safety provider
boundaries.evidence: Reference deployments may use deterministic runtime safety fixtures.
boundaries.remediation: Connect a live safe-browsing, reputation, redirect, or TLS-safety provider with privacy boundaries.

boundaries.title: Operator runbooks
boundaries.evidence: Operator handoff, failure, rotation, restore, and rollback responsibilities are documented.

boundaries.title: Backup and restore drill
boundaries.evidence: Source-of-truth restore procedure is documented and drillable.

boundaries.title: External governance audit
boundaries.evidence: External governance review is a future ecosystem-candidate obligation, not local proof.
boundaries.remediation: Obtain independent governance review before claiming ecosystem-candidate readiness.

review_notes: Future-stage or production-only warnings remain: nats_propagation, signing_custody, runtime_safety_provider, external_governance_audit.
Reference-backed evidence is acceptable for a reference claim, but production-candidate claims must replace it with operator-owned evidence.
